link.note: Descent from Bull Smith confirmed in two independent published genealogies (Gardiner 1890; Pelletreau 1898); probable overall because it depends on the links above Keturah.

summary: First Lady; John's 5th cousin 6x removed via Bull Smith → Richard 2d → Nathaniel Smith → Mary Smith Gardiner; the one genuine Virginia blood tie.
bio: Path: Bull Smith → Richard 2d → Nathaniel (m. Phoebe Howell) → Mary (b. 3 Oct 1725, m. 12 June 1745 Col. Abraham Gardiner, b. 1721/2) → Capt. Abraham Gardiner (1763–1796, m. Phoebe Dayton) → David Gardiner (1784–1844) → Julia. Married President John Tyler in 1844; lived at Sherwood Forest Plantation, Charles City County, Virginia. With Anna Symmes Harrison, both First Ladies of the 1840 'Tippecanoe and Tyler Too' ticket are John's cousins; neither president is.
sources: Gardiner, Lion Gardiner and his Descendants (1890) pp. 119, 147–149, https://archive.org/details/liongardinerhisd00gard
